_note: P3 마을 프랍(오너 지시 2026-08-15 '지형을 마을처럼 구성해'). 이름은 FieldDecor.GetPropNames()의 Biome.Field 목록과 VillageLayout이 요구하는 값 그대로 — 어긋나면 game_asset_names.py가 누락으로 잡는다.

rulesets.prop: Match the art style of the reference image EXACTLY: hand-drawn pixel art, same dot size, same limited earthy palette, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading, 3/4 top-down quarter view with a ~30 degree downward camera. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. A single object centered in frame, no text, no border, no extra props. The object stands alone with nothing drawn beneath it — no ground, no grass patch, no shadow of any kind. Background: completely flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF.

assets.name: village_house_0
assets.prompt: A small peasant cottage with whitewashed daub walls, dark timber framing beams, and a steep thatched straw roof. One shuttered window and a plank door on the front face. Weathered, lived-in, humble. Seen from a 3/4 elevated angle so both the front wall and one side wall are visible.

assets.name: village_house_1
assets.prompt: A slightly larger two-story village house with a stone ground floor and a timber upper floor that juts out over it. Red clay tile roof, a short chimney with faint smoke, two small windows. Seen from a 3/4 elevated angle so both the front wall and one side wall are visible.

assets.name: village_house_2
assets.prompt: A tiny sagging hut with a patched thatched roof, crooked timber walls, and a low doorway covered by a hanging cloth. Poorer and smaller than a cottage, leaning slightly. Seen from a 3/4 elevated angle so both the front wall and one side wall are visible.

assets.name: village_barn_0
assets.prompt: A wide low wooden barn with vertical dark plank walls, a broad sloped shingle roof, and tall double doors standing half open showing darkness inside. Seen from a 3/4 elevated angle so both the front wall and one side wall are visible.

assets.name: village_well_0
assets.prompt: A round village well built of stacked grey fieldstone, waist-high, with a wooden post frame over it holding a rope and a hanging bucket. Small wooden roof over the frame.

assets.name: village_fence_0
assets.prompt: A straight segment of rustic wooden fence: two horizontal weathered rails between squared posts, waist-high, grain visible, slightly uneven. The segment runs left to right across the frame.

assets.name: village_fence_1
assets.prompt: A wooden fence corner: two rail segments meeting at a right angle around a thicker corner post, waist-high, weathered timber.

assets.name: village_haystack_0
assets.prompt: A conical stack of dried golden hay piled around a central wooden pole, loose straw sticking out at the base, taller than a person.

assets.name: village_cart_0
assets.prompt: A wooden two-wheeled handcart with spoked wheels, its shafts tipped down to rest on the ground, a few sacks and a barrel loaded in the bed.

assets.name: village_lamp_0
assets.prompt: A tall wooden lamp post with an iron lantern housing at the top holding a small warm flame behind glass panes, a crossbar near the top.
